description: Source code for the main API endpoints of the notes backend service built with FastAPI. It defines REST API routes for health checks, listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, as well as middleware configuration.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint for the Notes API, returning service health status.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(query: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search query"))
methods.description: Endpoint to list all notes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: Note get_note(id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to retrieve"))
methods.description: Retrieve a single note by its ID.

methods.name: Note create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Create a new note with provided title and content.

methods.name: Note update_note( id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to update"), payload: NoteUpdate = ..., )
methods.description: Update an existing note identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: None delete_note(id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to delete"))
methods.description: Delete a note by its ID.

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to delete")) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to delete"))

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note(id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to retrieve")) -> Note:$/
ctags.signature: (id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to retrieve"))

ctags.name: list_notes
ctags.pattern: /^def list_notes(query: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search query")) /

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.signature: ( id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the note to update"), payload: NoteUpdate = ..., )
